_readme: Approved claims. A script may only state numbers and product claims listed here. Each fact needs a source you can show. Re-check before every campaign: pricing and features change. Edit this file in the app (Facts tab) or in %USERPROFILE%\InsidirStudio\facts.json.

facts.text: Corporate insiders must report most open-market trades in their company's stock to the SEC on Form 4 within two business days.
facts.source: SEC: Exchange Act Section 16(a) and Rule 16a-3(g); https://www.sec.gov/files/forms-3-4-5.pdf

facts.text: Form 4 filings are public SEC records anyone can read on EDGAR. They are not nonpublic information.
facts.source: SEC EDGAR full-text and ownership filings; https://www.sec.gov/edgar/search/

facts.text: Insidir imports new Form 4 filings from SEC EDGAR every 15 minutes.
facts.source: Insidir docs/COMPLIANCE.md (Research data) and the landing page figures band

facts.text: Insidir keeps open-market purchases and sales apart from awards, gifts and option exercises, and shows the SEC meaning of every transaction code.
facts.source: Insidir product: overview and insider activity pages

facts.text: Every insider trade in Insidir links to the original SEC filing.
facts.source: Insidir product: insider activity and personnel files link to SEC EDGAR

facts.text: Every reporting person has a file built only from public Form 4 records: roles, every transaction in plain words, and links to the filings.
You can follow insiders, and every trade they file shows up first on your overview.
Insidir has a company report for every company in the SEC's ticker list, with delayed prices, SEC financials, filings and insider activity.
New accounts can try Insidir for 3 days for $1; the plan then renews at $39 a month unless cancelled. Cancel any time.
facts.source: insidir.com landing and pricing pages (web/index.html: '$1 for 3 days, then $39 a month, cancel any time')

facts.text: Insidir is a research tool. It is not a broker and does not give investment advice.

end_card.headline: Insidir.
end_card.line: Read insider trades from SEC filings
